alerts.title: Weight gain attribution unclear
alerts.message: Guidelines note an association between DTG and abnormal weight gain but state the association may not be causal and could be due to less metabolic toxicity compared to older regimens. The patient has gained 12 kg over 3 years on TLD, with a BMI of 33. However, the patient also has symptomatic, untreated hypothyroidism (TSH 12.4 mIU/L), a classic non-drug cause of weight gain, fatigue, and dyslipidemia. The clinician's plan to switch from DTG due to weight gain may not address the primary underlying cause.

evidence.recommended_action: Evaluate and treat hypothyroidism first before attributing weight gain to DTG or considering an ART switch.

alerts.title: Untreated hypothyroidism
alerts.message: Patient has symptomatic hypothyroidism with TSH 12.4 mIU/L (target <4.5) and low Free T4, despite being prescribed levothyroxine. She reports often forgetting her thyroid tablet. Untreated hypothyroidism contributes to weight gain, fatigue, feeling cold, constipation, and dyslipidemia (total cholesterol 6.4 mmol/L). This is a significant monitoring gap and comorbidity management issue.

evidence.recommended_action: Reinforce adherence to levothyroxine, re-check TSH in 6-8 weeks, and manage dyslipidemia per guidelines.

alerts.title: Dyslipidemia and DTG monitoring
alerts.message: Patient has dyslipidemia (LDL 4.2 mmol/L, total cholesterol 6.4 mmol/L, triglycerides 2.3 mmol/L) and a BMI of 33. Guidelines recommend screening for hyperglycaemia risk factors including age ≥30 and BMI ≥25, which this patient has. Fasting glucose is currently normal (5.6 mmol/L). Ongoing monitoring for metabolic complications is required.

evidence.recommended_action: Monitor fasting glucose annually and manage cardiovascular risk factors, including dyslipidemia.

alerts.title: Viral load monitoring schedule
alerts.message: Guidelines recommend viral load monitoring every 6 months for patients on DTG-based ART. The patient's last viral load was >100 days ago (<50 copies/mL on 2025-11-10). The clinician's plan does not include ordering the next scheduled viral load test.

evidence.recommended_action: Order a viral load test today as per the 6-month monitoring schedule.
